blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.
blocks.zh: 数字技术使伊斯兰叙事更容易获得,但现有的平台为有条理地学习和理解这些故事提供了有限的支持,特别是在阿拉伯语和多语言环境中。 我们介绍ILM,一个先知故事互动教育平台,将阿拉伯语自然语言处理、结构化的知识表现和基于检索的问题生成结合起来。 管理批准的阿拉伯语叙事由知识图形(KG)建构引擎处理,该引擎将实体和叙事关系确定为结构化知识并将其存储,使学习者能够通过视觉故事地图探索故事,并解答由KG产生的基于实体和关系的问题. 另外,一个多语种检索管道从原始叙述中检索相关段落,以产生多种选择和开放式理解问题。 对于开放式问题,一名LLM-as-a-Judge根据检索的段落评价学习者的答案和参考答案,以确定正确性。 该平台还将《古兰经》的内容作为一个单独的浓缩层,允许以来源支持的信息补充选定的叙述。 通过将结构化的知识与基于通道的检索相结合,ILM支持阿拉伯语和多语种内容的叙事探索、理解和评估。 该系统表明,将结构化的知识表现和基于检索的生成结合起来,以支持互动学习伊斯兰叙事是可行的。 可在匿名4open.science/r/mml-5FCF上提供演示。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Knowledge, or ilm, holds an important position in Islam and is highly valued by Muslims. Islamic knowledge has historically been passed from one generation to the next through teaching, study, narration, and direct engagement between teachers and learners. Narration has an important role in Islamic knowledge transmission, particularly through a framework and method called qaṣaṣ (Qur’anic narratives). The Qur’an uses narrative to convey guidance and lessons, highlighting its pedagogical significance within Islamic education [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 知识,或说ilm,在伊斯兰教中占有重要地位,并被穆斯林高度评价. 伊斯兰知识历来通过教学、学习、叙事和教师与学习者之间的直接接触从一代传入下一代。 叙事在伊斯兰知识传播中起着重要作用,特别是通过一个叫做qaṣaṣ(古兰经叙事)的框架和方法。 《古兰经》用叙事来传达指导和教训,突出其在伊斯兰教育中的教学意义[27]。

blocks.en: In today’s world, the way knowledge is transmitted has changed significantly with the rise of digital technologies where information is now more widely available and accessible than before. On the other hand, digital platforms have become an increasingly common medium through which people learn. However, the availability of information through digital platforms does not necessarily ensure meaningful engagement or learning. Recent studies have shown that digital storytelling of prophetic narratives can support moral and religious character formation, as well as learner motivation and engagement, particularly when stories are well designed and appropriately mediated by adults [ 4 , 20 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 在当今世界上,随着数字技术的兴起,知识的传播方式发生了显著变化,现在比以前更广泛地提供和获取信息。 另一方面,数字平台已成为人们学习的日益常见的媒介. 然而,通过数字平台提供信息不一定能确保有意义的参与或学习。 最近的研究显示,数字故事讲述预言性叙事可以支持道德和宗教人物的形成,以及学习者的积极性和参与性,特别是当故事由成年人精心设计和适当调解时[4,20,21].

blocks.en: Therefore, we developed a storytelling platform for children and young adults that combines reading, visualization, and interactive learning. We begin by focusing on prophetic stories. Through an interactive story map, users can visualize key entities in each story, such as the prophets and other people, locations, and important objects, and explore the relationships between them. They can also evaluate their understanding of the stories through quizzes that assess both factual knowledge and story comprehension.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们为儿童和青年人开发了一个讲故事平台,将阅读、视觉和互动学习结合起来。 我们首先着重讲述预言故事。 通过交互式的故事地图,用户可以将每个故事中的关键实体,如先知和其他人,地点,和重要对象等进行可视化,并探索他们之间的关系. 他们还可以通过对事实知识和对故事的理解进行评估的测验来评价他们对故事的理解。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A range of apps and AI systems have risen to support the learning and exploration of prophetic and Islamic stories. Apps such as Qissah [ 6 ] and Qalam [ 5 ] provide 40+ narrated Qur’an and prophet stories with professional voiceover and multilingual support, while platforms such as Thurayya [ 17 ] , Miraj Stories [ 16 ] , Quran Stories 4 Kids [ 23 ] , and Kisah Nabi [ 22 ] combine animated or interactive stories, audio narration, and games to present sīrah and qiṣaṣ al-anbiyā’ in engaging formats. Conversational AI has also begun to be used in Islamic education, with general-purpose systems such as ChatGPT [ 19 ] and specialized systems such as MuslimGPT [ 28 ] , TheoAI [ 15 ] , providing sourced answers grounded in the Qur’an and authenticated hadith.
blocks.zh: 一系列的应用和AI系统已经崛起,以支持对预言和伊斯兰故事的学习和探索. Qissah [6]和Qalam [5] 等应用提供了40+叙事的《古兰经》和先知故事,并配有专业的语音和多语种支持,而诸如Thurayya [17]、Miraj Stories [16]、《古兰经》故事4 Kids [23] 和Kisah Nabi [22] 等平台则结合了动画或交互式故事、音频叙事和游戏,以互动形式呈现sīrah和qiṣaṣ al-anbiyā’。 对话式AI也开始被用在伊斯兰教育中,其通用系统有ChatGPT[19]等,而专门系统有MuslimGPT[28],TheoAI[15]等,提供了以《古兰经》为基础并经过认证的自来自来的答复。

blocks.en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have been used in Islamic texts to structure entities and relations in Qur’anic and hadith corpora for semantic search and question answering [ 13 , 26 , 25 ] . More generally, narrative-centric KGs represent events, entities, and temporal or causal links to support story understanding and interactive exploration [ 7 , 18 , 8 ] . Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks further combine LLMs with retrieved context, with recent work exploring temporally coherent passage assembly for narrative QA [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 知识图(KGs)在伊斯兰文字中被用来构建"古兰经"(Quar'anic)和"Hatith corpora"中的实体和关系,用于语义搜索和问答[13,26,25]. 更一般地说,以叙事为中心的KG代表事件,实体,以及时间或因果关系,以支持故事的理解和互动探索[7,18,8]. 检索增强的生成(RAG)框架进一步将LLMs与检索的上下文结合起来,最近的工作是探讨在时间上一致的通过组装说明性质量保证[14]。

blocks.en: Despite these developments, most work remains English-focused, with limited support for Arabic and educator control. We address these gaps through Arabic- and English-based learning that enables learners to explore narrative structure and relationships, assess factual and comprehension-based knowledge, receive story-grounded feedback, and learn from educator-controlled content.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,大多数工作仍以英语为主,对阿拉伯语和教育工作者控制的支持有限. 我们通过基于阿拉伯语和英语的学习来弥补这些差距,这些学习使学习者能够探索叙事结构和关系,评估基于事实和理解的知识,接收基于故事的反馈,并学习教育者控制的内容。

blocks.en: 3 System Architecture and Design
blocks.zh: 3 系统建筑和设计

blocks.en: The platform comprises end-user and administrative web portals built with React.js and connected to a FastAPI backend. PostgreSQL serves as the primary data store, with pgvector supporting vector storage and similarity search. The backend integrates a KG Constructor Engine (KG Engine) for structured knowledge extraction from Arabic narratives approved by educators with admin privileges, and a multilingual retrieval pipeline for question generation and answer evaluation. Figure 1 presents the overall architecture.
blocks.zh: 该平台包括最终用户和行政网络门户,这些门户由React.js所建并连接到FastAPI后端. PostgreSQL作为主数据库,由pgvector支持向量存储和相似性搜索. 后端集成一个KG构造器引擎(KG Engine),用于从具有管理员特权的教育工作者批准的阿拉伯语叙事中进行结构化的知识取出,并集成一个多语言检索管道,用于问答评价. 图1列出了总体结构。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall architecture of the proposed ILM platform.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 拟议的ILM平台的总体架构.

blocks.en: 3.1 Knowledge Graph Constructor Engine
blocks.zh: 3.1 知识图形构造引擎

blocks.en: The KG Engine constructs a story-specific KG from Arabic paragraphs through named entity recognition (NER), story-scoped entity linking, candidate pair generation, relation extraction, and semantic resolution. Extracted entities and relations are converted into structured KG records.
blocks.zh: KG引擎通过命名的实体识别(NER),故事范围实体链接,候选对子生成,关系提取,和语义解析,从阿拉伯语段落构建出一个故事特有KG. 被提取的实体和关系被转换成结构化的KG记录.

blocks.en: Each paragraph is processed using a four-expert nested NER ensemble comprising AraBERTV2 [ 3 ] , CAMELBERT-Mix [ 12 ] , MARBERTV2 [ 1 ] , and an AraBERTv2 span-based expert. An entity span is retained when at least two experts produce an exact-span match. XLM-R [ 10 ] is additionally used as a complementary safe-addition component for mentions not sufficiently supported by the primary ensemble. The resulting mentions are passed to a story-scoped Islamic entity linker, which maps surface forms, aliases, titles, and pronouns to canonical entities within the story.
blocks.zh: 每个段落都使用由四位专家组成的NER NER 组合处理,其中包括AraBERTV2 [3],CAMELBERT-Mix [12],MARBERTV2 [1],以及一位基于AraBERTv2跨度的专家. 当至少两名专家提出精确的比对时,保留一个实体的比值。 XLM-R [10]作为补充性安全添加组件,用于未得到充分初级组合支持的提及。 由此产生的提法被传递给一个故事范围伊斯兰实体链接器,该链接器将表面形式,化名,标题,代名词映射到故事中的犬科实体.

blocks.en: After entity linking, candidate entity pairs are passed to a two-stage relation extraction pipeline. An AraBERT-based binary classifier first identifies related pairs, followed by a relation classifier using the WOJOOD relation scheme [ 2 ] . The top-5 relations are then evaluated by an NLI model using the original text as the premise to resolve semantic ambiguities, such as birth place versus lives in . Selected relation types are further refined by relation-specific resolvers for family, prophetic mission, and major events before being added to the knowledge graph.
blocks.zh: 在实体连接后,候选实体的对被传递给一个两相关系提取管道. 一个基于AraBERT的二进制分类器首先识别出相關對,再由使用WOJOOD关系方案的关系分类器[2]. 然后,NLI模式对顶端的5个关系进行评估,将原始文本作为解决语义模糊问题的前提,例如出生地和居住地。 部分关系类型在被添加到知识图之前,通过针对家庭,预言任务,以及重大事件的特定关系解析器被进一步完善.

blocks.en: The extraction pipeline operates over the broader WOJOOD ontology [ 2 ] , while the educational application exposes nine controlled predicates: child_of , father_of , sibling_of , sent_to , thrown_into , taken_to , imprisoned_in , appointed_over , and reunited_with . Although the KG Engine extracts relations from the full WOJOOD ontology [ 2 ] , only nine selected relations are used in the educational application for learner activities and deterministic assessment.
blocks.zh: 提取管道运行在更广泛的WOJOOD本体[2]上,而教育应用则暴露出9个受控制的上游:孩子(of),父亲(father_of),兄弟(sible_of),被送去(to),被扔去(to),被带去(to),被囚禁(in),被任命(over),以及与(to)团聚(to). 虽然KG引擎从完整的WOJOOD本体学中提取关系[2],但在教育应用中只使用了9个选定的关系,用于学习者的活动和决定性的评估.

blocks.en: The extracted entities, mentions, and relations are converted into structured knowledge graph records before being stored in database. Each relation is validated against its entity endpoints and stored together with information about its source and extraction process. This includes the supporting paragraph, source information, original relation prediction, and, where applicable, the semantic resolution rule used to obtain the final relation. The graph is maintained in synchronization with the approved narrative content. When a paragraph is modified, the KG records previously associated with that paragraph are retracted and the updated paragraph is processed again.
blocks.zh: 被取出的实体,提及,关系被转换成结构化的知识图记录后再被存储入数据库. 每个关系都以实体的终点验证,并连同其来源和提取过程的信息一并储存。 这包括支持段落,来源信息,原始关系预测,以及在适当情况下,用于获取最终关系的语义解析规则. 图表与核准的叙事内容保持同步. 在修改一款时,收回原先与该段有关的KG记录,并再次处理更新的一款。

blocks.en: A separate Quran enrichment layer is derived from the Tanzil Quran Text–Simple Clean v1.1 (CC BY 3.0) [ 24 ] . Relations are manually verified against the Quranic source and stored with their corresponding verses. This layer adds relations such as interpreted_for , tempted , and summoned , but remains separate from the nine-predicate educational ontology and is excluded from deterministic quiz generation. Entity representation is conservative and limited to information explicitly supported by the source, distinguishing verified Quranic knowledge from automatically extracted narrative knowledge.
blocks.zh: 单独的可兰经浓缩层取自"坦齐尔可兰经"文本-简单清洁 v1.1 (CC BY 3.0) [24]. 关系由手动对照"古兰经"来源核实,并存有相应的诗句. 这一层增加了一些关系,如解释性、诱惑性、召见性,但与九品教育本体论不同,被排除在确定性问答之外。 实体代表是保守的,仅限于来源明确支持的信息,区分经核实的可兰经知识与自动提取的叙事知识.

blocks.en: 3.2 Multilingual Retrieval and RAG Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 多语言检索和RAG管道

blocks.en: The retrieval pipeline operates independently of the KG Engine and supports passage-based open-ended question generation and evaluation. Each approved narration is divided into paragraphs, with approved translations maintained across languages. Following human review, each paragraph translation is indexed as a retrieval chunk, preserving a direct mapping between retrieved content and its source paragraph. Chunks are embedded using Cohere’s embed-multilingual-v3.0 model [ 9 ] , producing 1024-dimensional representations stored in PostgreSQL with pgvector and an HNSW index for efficient cosine-similarity search. Arabic text is normalized before embedding and retrieval to reduce surface-form variation.
blocks.zh: 取回管独立于KG引擎运行,并支持基于通道的可开放式问题生成和评价. 每项核准的说明分为几段,各语文的核定译文均保留。 经过人文审查,每个段落的翻译都作为检索块编制索引,保持检索内容与其源段落之间的直接映射。 Chunks被嵌入使用Cohere所嵌入-多语言-v3.0模型[9],生成了PostgreSQL所存储的有pgvector和用于高效同位素搜索的HNSW索引的1024维表示. 阿拉伯文文本在嵌入和取回之前实现正常化,以减少表面形态的变化。

blocks.en: For question generation, the administrator specifies the story, language, question type, and number of questions. The query is embedded and matched against the chunk embeddings, with the top k = 3 k=3 chunks provided to Gemini 3.6 Flash [ 11 ] as source context. The model is instructed 1 1 1 See Appendix A.1 . to generate questions solely from the retrieved passages. Post-generation checks verify answer support against the source passages, detect within-chunk duplicates using Jaccard word overlap ( ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 ), and flag potentially redundant questions across the story using embedding similarity ( > 0.78 >0.78 ) for manual review. Duplicate generation is retried once before the question is discarded.
blocks.zh: 对于问题生成,管理员指定了故事,语言,问题类型,以及问题的数量. 查询被嵌入并与块嵌入相匹配,上方k=3克=3块提供给双子座 3.6 Flash [11] 作为源上下文. 型号被指示 11 1 见附录 A.1. 仅从取回的段落中产生问题。 生成后检查对照出源通道验证解答支持,检测出使用Jaccard单词相重叠的Chunk内部重复(  0.6\geq 0.6),并用嵌入相似性( > 0.78>0.78)来标出整个故事中潜在的冗余问题来进行人工审查. 重复生成在问题被丢弃前被重试一次.

blocks.en: 3.3 Question Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 问题评价

blocks.en: The end-user portal combines two assessment mechanisms: knowledge-graph-based questions and retrieval-based open-ended questions. After completing all paragraphs of a story, the learner can attempt the corresponding quiz. The two question types use different evaluation strategies because they rely on different representations of the underlying knowledge.
blocks.zh: 最终用户门户网站结合了两个评估机制:以知识为基础的问题和以检索为基础的开放式问题。 在完成一个故事的所有段落后,学习者可以尝试相应的测试. 这两个问题类型使用不同的评价战略,因为它们依赖于对基本知识的不同表述。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Knowledge-Graph-Based Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 以知识为基础的评价

blocks.en: Knowledge-graph-based questions use the story knowledge graph as the source of truth. Questions are generated from graph triples representing entities and relations, with each question linked to its source triple and expected answer. This enables deterministic evaluation without a language model: answers are normalized and matched against the canonical graph value and registered aliases, while multiple-choice answers are determined directly from the corresponding graph entity or relation.
blocks.zh: 以"知识-图"为本的问题以"故事知识图"为出自真理. 问题来自代表实体和关系的三相图,每个问题都与其来源的三相和预期答案相联系。 这使得没有语言模型的确定性评价成为可能:解答是正常的,并与犬形图值和已注册的别名相匹配,而多选择解答则直接由相应的图体或关系决定.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Retrieval-Based Answer Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 基于检索的回答评价

blocks.en: For retrieval-based open-ended questions, the learner’s question is embedded and used to retrieve the top k = 3 k=3 relevant chunks from the same story and language. The retrieved passages, together with the learner’s answer and the reference answer, are provided to Gemini [ 11 ] for evaluation. The retrieved passages serve as the evidence available to the evaluator, ensuring that the assessment remains grounded in the approved narrative content. Gemini [ 11 ] determines whether the learner’s answer is correct based on the retrieved evidence while allowing for reasonable differences in phrasing, spelling, and grammar. When the retrieved passages do not contain sufficient information to establish that an answer is incorrect, the system follows a benefit-of-the-doubt policy rather than penalizing the learner based on information unavailable in the retrieved context. The model returns a correct or incorrect and learner-facing feedback.
blocks.zh: 对于基于可检索的开放式问题,学习者的问题被嵌入并用于从同一种故事和语言取回顶端的 k = 3 k = 3 相关块. 检索的段落,连同学习者的回答和参考答案,提供给双子座[11]以供评价. 取回的段落是评价人员掌握的证据,确保评估以核准的叙述内容为基础。 双子座[11]根据所取出的证据确定学习者的答案是否正确,同时允许在用词,拼写和语法上存在合理的差异. 当检索到的段落没有包含足够的信息来确定一个答案是不正确的时,该系统遵循的是 " 万无一失 " 的政策,而不是根据检索到的信息对学习者进行惩罚。 该模型返回一个正确或不正确和学习者的反馈。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We presented ILM, an interactive educational platform that combines structured knowledge representation and multilingual retrieval to support learning from Islamic narratives. ILM establishes a framework for connecting narrative content with interactive exploration and comprehension assessment while maintaining links to the underlying source material. This work provides a foundation for extending Arabic and multilingual educational applications and for future empirical evaluation with learners and educators. The platform can support accessible and interactive learning of Islamic narratives. However, automatically extracted relations and generated questions may contain errors, which we mitigate through approved narrative content, human review, and source-verified Quranic enrichment. A demonstration video showcasing the ILM platform and its interactive learning capabilities is available here: demo video .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了ILM,这是一个互动的教育平台,将结构化的知识表述和多语种检索结合起来,以支持从伊斯兰叙事中学习。 国际LM建立了一个框架,将叙述内容与互动探索和理解评估联系起来,同时保持与源材料的联系。 这项工作为推广阿拉伯语和多语种教育应用以及今后对学习者和教育工作者进行经验评价奠定了基础。 该平台可以支持伊斯兰叙事的无障碍互动学习. 然而,自动提取的关系和产生的问题可能包含错误,我们通过核准的叙述内容、人文审查和源码验证的可兰经丰富来减轻错误。 展示ILM平台及其互动学习能力:演示视频。

blocks.en: 5 Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 未来工作

blocks.en: Several directions can further extend the platform. First, we plan to expand the story corpus to include a wider range of prophetic narratives and evaluate the system across different texts, as the current study is limited by its evaluation on a single story. Second, we aim to conduct formal empirical studies with children and educators to measure the efficacy of the platform in improving narrative comprehension, engagement, and knowledge retention. Third, we could also further improve engagement by incorporating multimedia such as GIFs, animations, and short videos, along with more interactive assessment activities such as matching characters and relationships, ordering events, and completing story maps.
blocks.zh: 若干方向可以进一步扩展平台. 首先,我们计划扩大故事本体,以包括更广泛的预言性叙事,并评价不同文本的系统,因为目前的研究受到其对单一故事的评价的限制. 第二,我们的目标是与儿童和教育工作者进行正式的经验性研究,以衡量该平台在改善叙事理解、参与和知识保留方面的效力。 第三,我们还可以通过纳入多媒体,如全球信息数据库、动画和短视频,以及更互动的评估活动,如匹配人物和关系、订购活动以及完成故事地图,来进一步改善参与。

blocks.en: Appendix A Gemini 3.6 Flash Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录A 双子座 3.6闪光提示

blocks.en: A.1 Open-Ended Question Generation Prompt
blocks.zh: A.1 不限题生成提示

blocks.en: You write reading-comprehension questions for children aged age .
blocks.zh: 你为年龄大的孩子写读懂问题

blocks.en: Use ONLY the SOURCE provided below. Do not add names, events, places, or details that are not present in the SOURCE. If the SOURCE does not provide enough information to answer a question, do not ask about it.
blocks.zh: 仅使用下文提供的资源。 不添加资源库中没有的名称、事件、地点或细节。 如果资源小组没有提供足够的信息来回答一个问题,请不要问这个问题。

blocks.en: Write ONE open-ended question that requires the child to answer in their own words, using one or two sentences. The question must be answerable from the SOURCE alone.
blocks.zh: 写出一个无限制的问题,要求孩子用自己的话回答,用一两句. 这个问题必须仅由资源来源来回答。

blocks.en: Ask about the story itself, not about the writing or the source. Do not use phrases such as according to the text” or the story states.”
blocks.zh: 问故事本身,不是写作或来源. 不要使用诸如根据文字的短语"或故事的表述. “

blocks.en: Also provide the expected answer as one short sentence that a child might reasonably write.
blocks.zh: 还将预期的答案作为儿童可以合理写作的短句。

blocks.en: Write everything in language .
blocks.zh: 用语言写一切

blocks.en: avoid
blocks.zh: 避免

blocks.en: Return only valid JSON in the following format:
blocks.zh: 仅以下列格式返回有效的 JSON :

blocks.en: {"prompt": "...", "reference_answer": "...", "explanation": "..."}
A.2 Open-Answer Judge Prompt
blocks.zh: A.2 公开答辩法官

blocks.en: A child aged age was asked a question about a story and wrote an answer.
blocks.zh: 一个年龄大的孩子被问到一个故事的问题,并写了答案.

blocks.en: Decide whether the child’s answer correctly answers the QUESTION using ONLY the PASSAGES provided below. Do not use any outside knowledge or information about the story.
blocks.zh: 决定孩子的回答是否正确 仅使用下面提供的 PASSAGES 。 不要使用任何外界对故事的了解或信息.

blocks.en: If the PASSAGES do not provide enough information to determine whether the answer is correct, give the child the benefit of the doubt and mark the answer as correct.
blocks.zh: 如果PASSAGES没有提供足够的信息来确定答案是否正确,则给予孩子怀疑的好处并标记答案正确.

blocks.en: Be generous about wording, spelling, grammar, and sentence structure. The child does not need to use the same words as the expected answer. Mark an answer as correct when its meaning is consistent with the PASSAGES and it demonstrates understanding of what the question asks.
blocks.zh: 宽宏大量的措辞,拼写,语法,和句子结构. 儿童不需要使用与预期答案相同的词. 当答案的含义与PASSAGES一致并表明对问题的理解时,将答案标为正确。

blocks.en: Mark an answer as incorrect only when: • it contradicts information in the PASSAGES; • it gives information that is incompatible with the PASSAGES; or • it fails to answer the main point of the QUESTION.
blocks.zh: 只有在以下情况下才将答案标为不正确: 与PASSAGES中的信息相矛盾; 提供与PASSAGES不相符合的信息; 或 未能回答问题的要点.

blocks.en: it contradicts information in the PASSAGES;
blocks.zh: 它与PASSIES中的信息相矛盾;

blocks.en: it gives information that is incompatible with the PASSAGES; or
blocks.zh: (一) 提供与《准则》不符的信息;或

blocks.en: it fails to answer the main point of the QUESTION.
blocks.zh: 它未能回答问题的要点。

blocks.en: Do not require every detail from the reference answer if the child’s answer is otherwise correct. Do not mark an answer wrong merely because it is incomplete in a minor way, uses different wording, or contains harmless spelling or grammar mistakes.
blocks.zh: 如果孩子的回答不正确,请不要要求参考答案中的所有细节。 不要仅仅因为一个回答不完整,使用不同的措辞,或者包含无害的拼写或语法错误,就标记错误.

blocks.en: Write feedback for the child in language , using one short, encouraging sentence. If the answer is correct, briefly say what they got right. If the answer is incorrect, kindly provide the correct answer based only on the PASSAGES. Never mention passages, sources, texts, evaluation, or judging.
blocks.zh: 用语言为孩子写回馈, 如果答案是正确的,请简要地说出他们得到了什么。 如果答案不正确,请仅根据PASSAGES提供正确的答案。 从不提及段落、来源、文本、评价或判断。

blocks.en: A.3 Shared Block for Question Generation Prompt
blocks.zh: A.3 问题生成提示共享块

blocks.en: Shared injected block ( avoid )
blocks.zh: 共享注入区块( 避免 )

blocks.en: These questions have already been asked about this same passage. Ask about something else in it, a different detail, person, action, or consequence. Do not rephrase or repeat any of them: {existing}
blocks.zh: 已经就同一段提出了这些问题。 问里面的别的东西, 一个不同的细节,人,行动,或者后果。 不要重写或重复其中任何一种 :{已存在}
